# ReportRoom
> Publishing layer AI agents call directly: one API/MCP call -> a beautiful, analytics-instrumented live URL.
## Docs
- REST API: https://docs.reportroom.io/api
- MCP: https://docs.reportroom.io/mcp
## Endpoints
- API base: https://api.reportroom.io
- MCP: https://mcp.reportroom.io/mcp (OAuth 2.1 for claude.ai connectors, or Bearer rr_live_ key for Claude Code)
## URL model
- Each account gets a handle (subdomain), auto-generated at signup (an opaque token like u7k2m9qp), renameable via POST /v1/handle or the set_handle tool (e.g. to acme). Published URLs look like https://<handle>.reportroom.io/<slug>. slug is unique per account; re-publishing updates in place.
- Email verification is required to publish: a new account is unverified and gets an API key, but POST /v1/documents (and the publish tool) return 403 email_unverified until the emailed link is clicked. GET /v1/verify?token= flips the account to verified and unlocks publishing. While unverified the reported base is https://<handle>.rrpreview.com (noindex) — you can't publish to it until verified.
## Capabilities
- Publish HTML or markdown -> live URL (decks + reports; charts render server-side from an ECharts option JSON block; hosted images become styled figures/galleries; optional cover_image; the workspace logo badges every doc once set via /v1/branding). Mode-A (raw HTML) opts into the design-system stylesheet by using a <main class="deck|report"> shell or a var(--token) reference — otherwise it's served exactly as authored. The design system is dark-mode aware (prefers-color-scheme; .slide.dark for a forced-dark slide).
- Whitelabel: Free-plan documents carry a "Published with ReportRoom" credit (fixed pill on Mode A, shell footer on Mode B); every paid plan (Pro/Team/Business) removes it.
- Hosted images: POST /v1/images (or the upload_image tool) -> content-addressed path to reference in documents. 2 MB/file, plan caps, public or team visibility.
- PDF export: POST /v1/documents/<slug>/export (or export_pdf tool) -> print-quality PDF. 5 credits; Idempotency-Key makes retries charge once; MCP returns a signed 1-hour download URL.
- Data rooms (Business): gated document collections served at https://<handle>.reportroom.io/room/<slug> (access modes public/email/passcode/allowlist; NDA + expiry + CRM-webhook settings) with per-viewer analytics + lead capture — 7 MCP tools from create_data_room to get_room_analytics (max 10 rooms/workspace, 200 viewers/room).
- Custom domains (Team/Business): POST /v1/domains -> your own hostname + DNS records (CNAME + validation TXT); GET/DELETE to manage; MCP attach_domain streams provisioning progress.
- Analytics: GET /v1/documents/<slug>/analytics (or get_analytics) -> 7-day views + relay-ready summary.
- Company billing: GET/PUT /v1/billing/profile (legal name, tax/VAT id, address -> printed on the Stripe invoice; PUT is owner-only) and GET /v1/billing/invoices (hosted + PDF links). Prices are exclusive of applicable taxes; no automatic tax calculation yet.
## Plans & limits (per workspace)
- Free: 10 docs, 10 images. Pro: 100 docs, 100 images. Team: unlimited docs, 500 images, + team-only visibility + custom domains. Business: unlimited docs, 1000 images, + data rooms. New accounts get 100 trial credits (PDF export costs 5). Over a cap -> 409 cap_reached; a gated feature off-plan -> 403 PLAN_REQUIRED/plan_required.
## Quickstart
- Clients: add https://mcp.reportroom.io/mcp as a custom MCP connector — Claude Code (claude mcp add --transport http), claude.ai (Settings > Connectors), ChatGPT (Developer mode > Connectors), or Codex (~/.codex/config.toml [mcp_servers]). OAuth signs in automatically, or use a Bearer rr_live_ key.
- MCP: claude mcp add --transport http reportroom https://mcp.reportroom.io/mcp ; call create_account, verify the email, then publish
- REST: POST /v1/signup {email} -> api_key ; verify email ; POST /v1/documents {content, content_format:"markdown", type:"deck", slug} with Authorization: Bearer -> url https://<handle>.reportroom.io/<slug>
